items.headline: Dollar gives back part of Friday's payrolls jump — DXY ~101.88 (-0.3-0.4%), EUR/USD ~1.1187, GBP/USD ~1.3411, USD/JPY ~157.99; NZD +1.0% to $0.5602 leads as risk rebounds (Reuters, Nov 9 London)
Dec Fed hike ~81% (CME FedWatch via Reuters, up from ~79% in Asia) into Tuesday's Oct CPI (7:30am CT, fcst +0.3% m/m, core +0.2%, no y/y) — the last CPI before the Dec 9 FOMC

Brent slides to $95.16 (-3.2%) as Trump plays down new Iran strikes ('highly unlikely' while talks progress); WTI ~$90.51 — oil extends last week's -16% slide, the geopolitical premium coming out of the global benchmark (Reuters)
Gold ~$4,121 (+1.25%) as softer oil eases inflation worries, into Tuesday's US CPI; silver +1.6% to $52.75 (Saxo/Reuters)
Bailey speaks 11:25am CT today, four days after the BoE hiked to 4.00% — first steer on whether December is back-to-back; UK GDP Thu (Q3 +0.7% q/q fcst) (FXStreet/Reuters)
Fed speakers due later today; US wholesale trade 9:00am CT, $58B 3Y auction 12:00pm CT — the only scheduled US items on a quiet Monday (Saxo/FXStreet)
China Oct CPI cools to 0.7% y/y (vs 0.8% fcst) as PPI jumps to 5.7% (vs 5.3%), a four-year high — the CPI–PPI gap widens to ~5pp; core CPI eases to 0.8%
Dec Fed hike ~79% (CME FedWatch via Reuters, up from 71% a week ago) after the +165K payrolls beat held through the weekend — Tuesday's Oct CPI (7:30am CT) is the next test
Japan spent a record $50bn in a single day (Jul 30) defending the yen, MoF data confirms — ~$97bn across Jul–Aug, incl. the first joint intervention with the US since 1998; USD/JPY ~158.3

Drone strike halts Iraq's Khor Mor gas field Sun night — LPG tank hit, fire doused, production suspended, ~2.8 GW of Kurdish power out; no casualties, no claim, no restart timeline (Dana Gas / Reuters)
Kiwi strongest overnight (+0.4–0.7%, NZD/USD ~0.5557–0.5585) as the NZ election leaves Luxon's coalition a paper-thin 67-seat majority; official result Nov 27
Asia rebounds as the AI rout pauses — Nikkei +2.6%, S&P futures +0.6%; Nvidia trades tonight on the Huang admission; gold ~$4,123 (+1.8%), Brent flat ~$98.3

IRGC lifts its self-imposed 2,000km ballistic-missile range limit (AP, Sat Nov 7): spokesman Gen. Hossein Mohebbi — 'That restriction has been lifted for us' — vows to 'demonstrate these capabilities in practice'; no evidence of a longer-range missile fielded; follows the supreme leader's warning of a response 'without geographical limits'

Houthis hit Riyadh Sun morning: Aramco Tower shrapnel damage in the financial district, coalition says two ballistic + two cruise missiles intercepted (some counts say three ballistic); no casualties, no supply disruption; Saturday Sanaa strikes killed 33

Trump told CNN a new Iran strike is 'highly unlikely' as diplomacy runs on — Doha still no deal, no confirmed US answer to the two-day proposal (blockade lift + frozen funds → Hormuz reopen day 2 → expanded nuclear talks)

NZ election preliminary count complete (99.4%): Labour won the party vote 29.36% vs National 29.21% (3,650 votes), but National+ACT+NZ First hold 67 of 131 seats — one above the line; ~399,365 special votes remain, official result Nov 27
items.source: Electoral Commission preliminary results via Reuters/BBC Nov 8 — https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealanders-vote-general-election-2026-11-06/

items.headline: BoC Dec hike odds faded to ~32-36% after the Canada jobs miss (swaps ~32% from 40% pre-jobs; OIS 36.4% Nov 7) — hold now the base case; Dec Fed hike ~76-77% holding into Tuesday's CPI
items.source: FinancialJuice via CryptoBriefing Nov 6 / rateprobability.com Nov 7 — https://cryptobriefing.com/boc-december-rate-hike-chances-drop-after-jobs-report/

items.headline: NZ election: preliminary count — NO clear winner. National 42 seats, Labour 36; National+ACT+NZ First hold 67 seats, a bare majority; Labour bloc 64. Opportunity crosses 5% (5.9%) and enters parliament for the first time. Official result Nov 27 after special votes; coalition talks to follow

Iran reviewing Qatar proposals (AP, Nov 6-7): two-day confidence measures — US lifts blockade, releases some frozen funds, Iran reopens Hormuz on day 2, IAEA inspectors into bombed sites — then expanded nuclear talks. Tehran holds to seven conditions before nuclear talks; Qatar PM Nov 7 'confident' a settlement can be reached; US carried out limited strikes Fri on an Iranian air-defense system
items.source: AP via Indian White Paper Nov 7 — https://indianwhitepaper.com/iran-reviews-qatar-proposal-to-revive-nuclear-talks-with-us ; EL7 Nov 7 — https://el7.ai/en/news/2026-11-07-qatar-proposes-interim-us-iran-deal-to-de-escalate-and-reopen-strait-of-hormuz

items.headline: Dec Fed hike odds ~77% holding into the weekend (Kalshi 76.5-78%, Polymarket 76.5%, CME futures 76.1% as of ~1-2pm ET Nov 7) after the +165K payrolls beat — into Tuesday's Oct CPI, the last CPI before the Dec 9 FOMC; BLS will not publish y/y rates (Oct 2025 data gap)
